problem: Traditional statistical interpolation between drillholes limits where to drill and grade estimates; Stratum uses deep learning to predict grade and suggest targets.
business_model: Project-based and software services for mining companies (pilots with projected value; later alliance with Major Drilling)
product_category: AI for mine planning and exploration targeting

founders.name: Daniel Mogilny
founders.background_notes: Five years of enterprise sales per YC bio

founders.name: Farzi Yusufali
founders.background_notes: Hardware engineering, quantum computing and ML; studied geology and mining; both founders listed as former founders on YC page

technical_complexity.rationale: Deep learning on sparse drillhole data in geoscience with limited training examples; domain expertise and validation are hard.

defensibility.rationale: Proprietary models and customer mine data could compound, but pilots are bespoke and unverified.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found on incumbent action.

market_need_then: YC page claims pilots project about US$10M annual value for the average mine (company claim); mining AI demand otherwise not sourced for 2020.

brand_strength.rationale: No source found about the brand itself; rated low-middle by default because nothing shows it drove growth.

outcome_analysis: StratumAI is still listed Active and shows commercial activity (a Kazakhstan gold project reported by Mining.com, a 2024 alliance with Major Drilling, 2023 conference papers), but funding is limited to a possible US$125-130K seed, and revenue and headcount are not public. Evidence shows a slow, services-style business rather than a clear venture outcome.
notes: CB Insights reports US$130K seed (Aug 2020) and Seedtable US$125K; aggregators only, so not recorded as a round. One directory lists Founders Fund, Aramco and Ilya Sutskever as backers, which conflicts and is not used. Founding year 2018 (CB Insights) vs 2019 (YC). YC lists both founders as former founders while status is Active; unclear who runs the company now. Mining.com article and Major Drilling alliance seen only in search summaries. No competitors dated near 2020 sourced. No shutdown or layoffs found. Name origin not found. Completeness pass: the seed rests on a single database (CB Insights, 130K on 2020-08-25); Seedtable gives 125K, so the amount conflicts and is not summed.
